rca_of_the_issue.original_bug: 500 Internal Server Error when logging in with Owner account in production
root_causes_identified: 1. Naive datetime comparison in check_brute_force - MongoDB may return naive datetimes which caused comparison errors with timezone-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc)
2. Missing password_hash field handling - If user record had no password_hash, bcrypt.checkpw would fail with exception
3. Motor DB boolean bug in orderflow_ws_service.py - 'if not self._db' was truthy for Motor database objects even when set
fixes_applied: 1. check_brute_force now normalizes naive datetimes to UTC-aware before comparison
2. login() checks for missing password_hash before calling verify_password
3. seed_admin handles missing password_hash with try/except
4. Fixed Motor DB boolean bug: 'if self._db is None' instead of 'if not self._db'
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend login flow works correctly. No 500 errors observed.
